verdict.rationale: PlanetScale is a database platform that acts as an MCP server provider: its hosted MCP server lets Claude, Cursor and other tools connect to it. Consuming third-party MCP servers as a client is not a capability a database platform would normally ship. PlanetScale Bot uses only PlanetScale's own MCP server and skills, so nothing in the evidence shows users can plug in external MCP servers, and the client-side axis does not apply.
